contentPattern.notes: Circular portrait photo, centered H3 name, uppercase grey H5 role/tagline, and a horizontal row of 3 social icon links (Facebook/Twitter/Instagram).

suitableFor: any repeatable person card (photo + name + role + social links)
notSuitableFor: article / destination card grids (use base cards block)
cards with landscape imagery and long descriptions

reuseVsBaseNote: Not reused from the existing 'cards' block: base cards is tailored to WKND article/destination cards (landscape 13/10 image, uppercase title, single-line ellipsis grey description) and has no support for a circular avatar, an H5 role line, or a social-icon row. Similarity to base cards is well below the 80% threshold on purpose, image pattern, and content structure, so a dedicated variant was created. Both the contributors and guides grids on the About Us page use this single variant.
